issue_context.title: Intermittent panic due to runtime being started within a runtime
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

unable to create MRE, but we've discussed this issue, i managed to get a backtrace @ritchie46 

doesn't happen consistently at all
